message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"Document submissions are being rejected because the audit journal is full, causing journal append failures and resulting in 507 errors from the intake-api service.","evidence_ids":["log:4","log:5","log:8","log:9"]},"missing_evidence":[],"observations":[{"claim":"The audit-journal service logs multiple errors indicating 'no space left on device' for /var/journal, showing the journal is full.","evidence_ids":["log:4","log:8"]},{"claim":"The audit-journal service logs warnings about the /var/journal volume being at 91% and 98% capacity, indicating disk space is critically low.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:3"]},{"claim":"The intake-api service logs errors of submission rejections due to audit journal write failures, returning 507 errors to clients.","evidence_ids":["log:5","log:9"]},{"claim":"The intake-api service logs a warning about an unrecognized client user-agent, but this is unrelated to the widespread submission rejections.","evidence_ids":["log:6"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check disk usage and free space on the /var/journal volume of the audit-journal service.","Verify audit-journal retention and compaction processes to ensure they are functioning and not blocked.","Review intake-api error logs for 507 responses and correlate with audit-journal errors."]}
